<% if projekt_feature?(@projekt_phase.projekt, "general.vc_map_enabled") %>
  <% provide :vc_maps do %>
    <script id="vcmap-core" type="module" src="/vcmap/vcmap-core.js"></script>
  <% end %>
<% end %>

<% if @landing_page.present? %>
  <%= render "pages/brand_color_styles", page: @landing_page %>
<% end %>

<%= render UserResources::FormComponent.new(
  @proposal,
  url: proposals_path,
  title: t("new.start_new", scope: "proposals")
) %>
=== UserResources::FormComponent ===
app/assets/stylesheets/custom_new_design/components/user_resources/form_component.scss
app/components/custom/user_resources/form_component.rb
app/components/custom/user_resources/form_component.html.erb

observation.command: cd /workspace && sed -n '1,50p' app/views/custom/proposals/new.html.erb; echo "=== UserResources::FormComponent ==="; find app -name "form_component*" -path "*user_resources*"; ls app/components/user_resources/ 2>/dev/null | head
